appBanner.heading: Take Blossom everywhere 📱
appBanner.sub: Our mobile app lets you browse, match and chat on the go — available on Android, coming soon on iOS.

0.a: Yes — creating a profile, browsing, and matching are completely free. We'll never charge you to send a like.

1.a: Women always send the first message. This keeps the experience respectful and intentional for everyone.

2.a: When you like someone and they like you back, it's a match! You'll get a notification and can start chatting straight away.

3.a: Absolutely. We never sell your data. Your profile is only visible to registered members, and you can delete your account any time.

4.q: Can I use Blossom on my phone?
4.a: Yes! Our Android app is available on Google Play. An iOS version is coming soon.

5.q: How do I delete my account?
5.a: Go to your profile settings and tap 'Delete Account'. Your data is permanently removed within 24 hours.
